answer:
Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) on BiFeO3 in the R3c perovskite structure with 10 atoms in the primitive cell, followed by an SCF calculation on the relaxed structure.
Build the starting structure as the rhombohedral primitive cell of R3c BiFeO3 (ibrav=5) with Bi at 2a, Fe at 2b, and O at 6e Wyckoff positions, using experimentally consistent lattice parameters (approximately a = 5.578 Angstrom, alpha = 59.98 degrees).
Use LDA pseudopotentials from PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard: bi.upf for Bi, fe.upf for Fe, o.upf for O.
Set the calculation as ntyp=3, nat=10 with the above pseudopotentials.
Set CELL_DYN in the &CONTROL section to enable variable-cell relaxation, with no external pressure (default zero pressure).
Set etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8 in &CONTROL.
Set forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7 in &IONS.
Set ecutwfc to 40 Ry and ecutrho to 4 times ecutwfc (160 Ry), appropriate for LDA PseudoDojo SR pseudopotentials.
Set nspin = 1 (non-spin-polarized), do not set starting_magnetization, do not set Hubbard U, and do not enable spin-orbit coupling.
In &SYSTEM set occupations = "fixed" and smearing is not used (insulator treatment).
In &ELECTRONS set conv_thr = 1.0e-8, mixing_beta = 0.7, and electron_maxstep = 200.
In &IONS set forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7 and nstep = 200.
In &CELL set cell_dofree = "all" to allow full cell relaxation, and press_conv_thr = 0.5 (default).
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with k-spacing parameter corresponding to a grid of 8 x 8 x 8 for the rhombohedral cell, and set the shift to "half" (i.e., offset = 0.5, 0.5, 0.5) via k-point shift settings (e.g., K_POINTS automatic with 8 8 8 1 1 1 for half-shift).
After the vc-relax completes successfully, run a separate SCF calculation (calculation = "scf") on the final relaxed structure, using the exact same settings: same pseudopotentials, same ibrav and celldm values taken from the relaxed output, same ecutwfc = 40 Ry and ecutrho = 160 Ry, same k-point grid (8 8 8 with half shift), same conv_thr = 1.0e-8, nspin = 1, occupations = "fixed".
Return the fully relaxed structure (final cell vectors, atomic positions, and cell parameters) and the final total energy from the SCF calculation in Hartree units.
